description: This file defines a class for rendering a triangle marker in an image graphing library. It extends a base marker class and implements a method to draw a triangle shape on a canvas, used as a data point indicator.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Triangle
classes.description: A class that represents a triangle-shaped marker for the image graphing library, capable of drawing itself on a canvas.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws a triangle marker at specified (x, y) position on the canvas by adding vertices and rendering a polygon.
